instruction: I went on a few trips each with some of my coworkers. My Simple Note has information on who owes whom what from each trip. I have already created Splitwise groups for the trips. Record the expenses accordingly in the respective groups.
notes: Assumes one Simple Note (found with query 'trip') lists, per trip, pairwise debts 'X owes Y $N'; each such line becomes one splitwise.record_expense with payer_email = Y, debtor_emails = [X], paid_amount = N, group_id = the existing group for that trip. The problem instantiates 2 trips/groups and 4 debt entries (matching the 11-call reference); the real counts come from the note content. Coworker emails and group ids are read from splitwise.show_groups (gated by (groups-listed)); entry details are gated by (note-read). Debt entries are domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can enumerate every goal condition without quantification. No answer is required, so complete_task takes no arguments.
